title: Audit and document existing budget-related service contracts
notes: Inventory current budget, estimate, materials, showroom, room, questionnaire, and bid-portfolio contracts before editing behavior.

title: Define `budget_tracker_item_links` Drizzle schema
notes: Persist evidence links from a budget tracker item revision to room, questionnaire track, estimate revision, estimate line item, material, showroom product, or bid portfolio.

title: Define `budget_alerts` Drizzle schema
notes: Persist durable budget warnings and action prompts for the workbench inbox.

title: Export new budget schemas through the home/schema index
notes: Keep schema aggregation consistent with the current repo pattern.

title: Generate Drizzle migration for budget links and alerts
notes: Create migration only after schema naming and indexes are finalized.

title: Create budget workbench aggregation service
notes: Unify planned, committed, selected, purchased, spent, room, estimate, and material/product state into one internal summary contract.

title: Define shared mutation service pattern for frontend and MCP parity
notes: Document and implement the rule that frontend actions and MCP actions must call the same business-logic path so revisioning, links, alerts, and downstream triggers stay identical.

title: Add rollup helpers for planned vs committed vs spent budget states
notes: Treat `budget_tracker_items` as planning, `budget_expense_entries` as actuals, and estimate/material/product data as intermediate evidence.

title: Add room-level budget aggregation to the workbench service
notes: Return room cards with budget totals, open blockers, estimate counts, and unresolved material decisions.

title: Add estimate reconciliation aggregation to the workbench service
notes: Summarize estimate revisions, mapped/unmapped lines, room coverage, and top variances.

title: Add materials and products aggregation to the workbench service
notes: Expose unpurchased materials, linked candidate products, selected purchases, and budget-impact metadata.

title: Persist selected-product state at the material layer
notes: Add explicit persisted selected-product state separate from purchased-product state. Purchased implies selected, but selected may later change before purchase.

title: Add alert recomputation logic
notes: Create alerts for unmapped estimate lines, over-target product choices, over-range rooms, and unreviewed questionnaire-generated budget items.

title: Create `/api/budget-workbench` router
notes: Own summary, rooms, estimates, materials, and decision inbox endpoints.

title: Implement `GET /api/budget-workbench/summary`
notes: Return executive strip rollups and top risk counts.

title: Implement `GET /api/budget-workbench/rooms`
notes: Return room cards for the workbench board.

title: Implement `GET /api/budget-workbench/estimates`
notes: Return estimate reconciliation summaries and unresolved mapping counts.

title: Persist estimate-to-budget links at both revision and line-item levels
notes: Support whole-estimate budget context plus exact line-item reconciliation. Do not choose only one level.

title: Implement `GET /api/budget-workbench/materials`
notes: Return material/product sourcing and purchase-decision data.

title: Implement `GET /api/budget-workbench/decision-inbox`
notes: Combine persisted alerts with unresolved operational records.

title: Implement `GET /api/budget-workbench/sync-history`
notes: Return budget-related sync and mutation history for a dedicated first-release sync-history surface.

title: Implement `POST /api/budget-workbench/links`
notes: Create or update evidence links from a budget tracker item to related artifacts.

title: Implement MCP-safe budget mutation endpoints/services with frontend-equivalent side effects
notes: Ensure MCP-triggerable mutations hit the same underlying services as frontend actions and preserve all resulting writes, alerts, revision steps, and follow-up processes.

title: Mount the budget workbench router in the API index
notes: Ensure route ordering does not conflict with existing budget routes.

title: Extend budget tracker responses with linked evidence
notes: Expose evidence links and alert summaries for item detail views.

title: Refactor frontend write flows onto shared backend mutation services
notes: Where frontend mutations currently embed behavior in route handlers, move that behavior into reusable services so MCP can invoke the same logic.

title: Extend estimates responses with reconciliation metadata
notes: Add unmapped-counts, room-coverage hints, and budget-line linkage support.

title: Add low-confidence estimate mapping classification
notes: Detect vague or weakly mapped estimate lines and stage them for explicit human review instead of forcing false certainty.

title: Extend materials responses with budget context
notes: Expose selected-vs-purchased state and budget-linked comparison metadata.

title: Extend room detail payload with material/product budget context
notes: Make room pages actionable for budget decisions without forcing users back to the workbench for everything.

title: Create Budget Workbench Astro page
notes: Mount a new React island and use the existing layout/auth shell.

title: Build `BudgetWorkbenchApp` executive strip and overview shell
notes: Implement the top-line rollups and primary navigation state.

title: Build sync-history view inside the workbench
notes: Expose budget edit audit history in the first release as a dedicated workbench state.

title: Build workbench decision inbox UI
notes: Render persistent alerts and unresolved records as action-oriented cards.

title: Build room budget board UI
notes: Render room cards with direct links into room detail and room-scoped problem solving.

title: Build estimate reconciliation board UI
notes: Surface estimate revisions, variance posture, and missing mapping actions.

title: Build manual mapping staging UI for unresolved estimate lines
notes: Render a focused unresolved-lines area that makes human-in-the-loop budget mapping explicit.

title: Build materials and product decision board UI
notes: Make sourcing and purchase decisions visible in the same operating surface.

title: Add contractor visibility preview to the workbench
notes: Preview the full internal contractor-shareability picture, including all budget-related context before public visibility rules are applied.

title: Add workbench entry to the admin budget navigation
notes: Place the new surface within the existing budget group.

title: Upgrade `BudgetAgent` to consume structured workbench services
notes: Replace toy snapshot behavior with summarization and suggestion tools over real workbench outputs.

title: Teach `BudgetAgent` to emit `needs_human_mapping` outcomes
notes: When estimate-line confidence is weak, the agent should route to human review instead of implying false confidence.

title: Add budget workbench helper methods for the agent
notes: Provide structured summaries, top drivers, unresolved items, and candidate mappings for agent consumption.

title: Document internal and contractor-visible budget data rules
notes: Clarify privacy and visibility boundaries before rollout.

title: Run verification across budget, room, materials, and estimate flows
notes: Verify typecheck, build, and critical manual paths for workbench, room detail, estimate review, materials, and bid portfolio preview. Also verify MCP-equivalent mutations produce the same persisted fields and downstream side effects as frontend actions.
